name: Yuhan Corporation
summary: Yuhan Corporation operates as a pharmaceutical company in South Korea and internationally. It offers manufacturing services, such as custom manufacturing; process research and development of active pharmaceutical products (APIs) and intermediates; kilo and pilot-scale production of APIs and intermediates; commercial production of APIs and intermediates; production of chemical specialties; and analytical method development and regulatory support.
